scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (netstat -ano | Select-String ':5000' | Select-String 'LISTENING')) { Start-Process -FilePath npm.cmd -ArgumentList @('run','backend') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location) -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput 'backend.out.log' -RedirectStandardError 'backend.err.log' }; if (-not (netstat -ano | Select-String ':5174' | Select-String 'LISTENING')) { Start-Process -FilePath npm.cmd -ArgumentList @('run','dev:admin') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location) -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput 'vite-admin.out.log' -RedirectStandardError 'vite-admin.err.log' }; Write-Host 'Backend API:    http://localhost:5000/'; Write-Host 'Admin Frontend: http://localhost:5174/'; Write-Host 'User Frontend:  http://localhost:5173/'; npm.cmd run dev:user"
scripts.ports:stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$listenerIds=netstat -ano | Select-String ':5173|:5174|:5000' | Where-Object { $_ -match 'LISTENING' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach ($listenerId in $listenerIds) { if ($listenerId -match '^\d+$') { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$listenerId) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
